chars.BOSS: a Moroccan man of about 42 with short black hair greying at the temples and a trimmed beard, wearing a burgundy quilted vest over a white long-sleeve shirt and dark jeans
chars.WORKER: a Moroccan woman of about 35 wearing a mustard-yellow headscarf, a long olive-green work tunic with a small blue apron, and white sneakers
chars.DAUGHTER: a Moroccan teenage girl of about 16 with a high black ponytail, wearing an oversized lilac hoodie, light-blue jeans and pink sneakers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from below at the foot of a concrete staircase inside a small Moroccan clothing workshop (sewing machines, fabric rolls): DAUGHTER stands halfway down the stairs, caught mid-act holding her smartphone up with both hands, filming downward, eyes wide and mouth open in shock, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, warm late-afternoon light

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Closer shot of DAUGHTER on the workshop stairs pointing her phone camera straight down at the viewer, recording, one eyebrow raised, a defiant cheeky look, the phone's back camera visible, blurred fabric rolls behind her

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside the Moroccan sewing workshop near a cutting table, BOSS and WORKER spring apart from each other in panic, both turning their heads up toward the staircase, frozen, shocked faces, awkward comic embarrassment, fully dressed, sewing machines around them

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: DAUGHTER on the workshop staircase screaming loudly with her eyes shut and her phone clutched to her chest, hair flying, dramatic comic moment, dust in the light from a small high window

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Wide shot of the workshop: DAUGHTER runs out through the open metal door into a narrow Moroccan street, WORKER chases after her with an arm stretched out, while BOSS stands frozen in the middle of the workshop like a statue, hands on his head, mouth open, stunned
